classification.difficultyReason: Select convenient input values for five supplied linear rules, calculate coordinates and draw all lines on a common plane with consistent axes/scales; familiar taught multi-step procedure with no new proof or modelling.

content.prompt: On a single set of axes, draw the graphs of:

spec.description: ONE common native blank graph response area for all five supplied linear rules.
spec.mathematics: Unlabelled blank grid only; students choose axes/scales.

answer.worked: Substitute $x=0,1,2$ into the rule to obtain $y=-6,-3,0$. Plot $(0,-6),\ (1,-3),\ (2,0)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.
Substitute $x=0,2,4$ into the rule to obtain $y=4,2,0$. Plot $(0,4),\ (2,2),\ (4,0)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.
Substitute $x=-2,0,2$ into the rule to obtain $y=3,4,5$. Plot $(-2,3),\ (0,4),\ (2,5)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.
Substitute $x=-4,0,4$ into the rule to obtain $y=-1,-2,-3$. Plot $(-4,-1),\ (0,-2),\ (4,-3)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.
Substitute $x=-1,0,1$ into the rule to obtain $y=5,2,-1$. Plot $(-1,5),\ (0,2),\ (1,-1)$ and draw the straight line on the same axes as the other parts.

spec.description: All five complete lines on one plane; editable per-part style key, no ink-overlapping curve legend.
